_readme: SCAYLE pack knowledge. Target-only pack: SCAYLE is a fully managed SaaS commerce engine with no client-side code base to scan, so there is no as_source block and no structural layer.

The two lists below are SEED and explicitly BEST-EFFORT: the vendor material describes capabilities and components but names almost no concrete API resources, so the entries were reconstructed from the vendor's component list plus general knowledge of API-first commerce engines. Verify every single entry against the current SCAYLE API reference before quoting it in a deliverable, and verify the feature behind it against the client's CONTRACT - on a modular SaaS, 'standard' means 'contracted'.

target_api_endpoint_families is split into Storefront API (shopper-facing) and Admin API (management) families, following the vendor's own component split; the vendor also mentions an Add-on API for extended modules and webhooks for outbound events. Protocol per family (REST and/or GraphQL) must be verified - the vendor states the Storefront API offers both.

target_content_component_types is deliberately unusual: no CMS module is listed, so what SCAYLE owns is ENTITY-BOUND content (product, category, brand, promotion, store), while non-entity-bound editorial content (landing pages, campaign pages, storytelling) comes from the storefront application or an external headless CMS. The list therefore names both, marked as such. See pack.json as_target.snippets.content_model_notes - estimate two content models, not one.
target_api_endpoint_families: Storefront API: products (product and variant detail, master/variant structure with size and colour dimensions)
Storefront API: product search and listing (filtering, sorting, pagination)
Storefront API: filters / facets and aggregations for category and search pages
Storefront API: search suggestions / autocomplete
Storefront API: categories and category tree
Storefront API: navigation trees (menu structures for the storefront)
Storefront API: brands and attribute groups
Storefront API: basket and basket items (add, update quantity, remove, price recalculation)
Storefront API: promotions and vouchers applied to a basket
Storefront API: wishlist and wishlist items
Storefront API: customers (registration, login, profile) and customer addresses
Storefront API: authentication / session and token issuance (verify the auth flow and token model)
Storefront API: orders (order creation from a basket, order lookup and status for the shopper)
Storefront API: payment and checkout session (PSP handoff - verify how much of checkout is API versus frontend)
Storefront API: shipping / delivery options and costs
Storefront API: stores, store details and store inventory lookup (omni-channel add-on - verify it is contracted)
Admin API: products, variants and product attributes (product master data maintenance)
Admin API: categories and category assignments
Admin API: prices, price lists and customer-group prices
Admin API: stock, warehouses and availability
Admin API: orders, order items and order status transitions
Admin API: customers and customer groups
Admin API: promotions, vouchers and campaigns
Admin API: shops / shop configuration, countries, currencies and languages
Admin API: media and asset management
Admin API: bulk import / data jobs for product, price and stock feeds (verify throughput and idempotency guarantees)
Admin API: webhook subscriptions and the outbound event catalogue (verify event names, retries, ordering and delivery guarantees in writing)
Add-on API: extended module surfaces such as omni-channel and wholesale (verify which add-ons the contract includes and what each exposes)
target_content_component_types: SCAYLE-owned: product and variant content attributes (name, description, material, care, fit)
SCAYLE-owned: product media set (image sets per variant, video - verify transformation and CDN behaviour)
SCAYLE-owned: product badge or label attribute (new, sale, sustainability markers)
SCAYLE-owned: category content (name, description, SEO text per category)
SCAYLE-owned: navigation tree entry (label, target, ordering)
SCAYLE-owned: brand content and brand attributes
SCAYLE-owned: filter and facet label configuration (the editorial surface of search)
SCAYLE-owned: promotion and campaign presentation (name, banner reference, validity)
SCAYLE-owned: voucher / discount campaign presentation
SCAYLE-owned: SEO metadata per entity (title, description, canonical, slug)
SCAYLE-owned: URL slug and redirect entry (verify whether redirects are managed in the engine or the frontend)
SCAYLE-owned: store profile content - address, opening hours, services (omni-channel add-on, verify)
SCAYLE-owned: internationalisation resources (language and currency configuration per shop)
SCAYLE-owned: transactional message content, e.g. order confirmation data (verify whether templates live in the engine or the frontend)
Frontend or external CMS: landing page and campaign page composition (NOT in the engine - verify)
Frontend or external CMS: editorial content block / component library (hero, editorial teaser, lookbook, shop-the-look, content-commerce module)
Frontend or external CMS: navigation and header/footer copy beyond the navigation tree labels
Frontend or external CMS: legal and service pages (imprint, terms, privacy, returns policy, size and fit guide)
Frontend or external CMS: blog / magazine article and storytelling content
Frontend or external CMS: consent and cookie banner content
Frontend or external CMS: email template layout and editorial email content
